name: 🥟 Pierogi Party + Salad
what: Frozen pierogies pan-fried golden with sweet buttery onions, with a crisp salad.
extras: sour cream, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, kielbasa or bacon, oil + vinegar dressing

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Slice the onions thin.
Cook the onions in butter over medium, stirring now and then, until soft and golden.
Meanwhile, boil the pierogies (see the box), then drain well.
Push the onions aside, add more butter and fry the pierogies golden on both sides.
Toss the salad with dressing. Pile onions on the pierogies; serve with sour cream.

key: Low and slow on the onions until golden and sweet.
done: Pierogies are golden brown on both sides.
plan_b: Skip the frying: air fry boiled pierogies at 400°F for 10–12 minutes.
